## County Information

### Description

Boyd County was named for Linn Boyd. The county is located in the northeast area of the state.[[2]](#cite_note-2)

### County Courthouse

**Boyd County Courthouse**  
2800 Louisa Street  
Catlettsburg, KY 41229  
Phone: 606-739-5116[[3]](#cite_note-3)  
[Boyd County Website](http://boydcountyky.gov/)

### Boyd County, Kentucky Record Dates
